xna-type.name: ChildCollection
xna-type.summary: Provides a collection of child objects for a content item.

parameters.parameter: Parent object of the child objects returned in the collection.

method.name: ClearItems
method.summary: Removes all children from the collection.

overload.summary: Removes all children from the collection.

method.name: GetParent
method.summary: Gets the parent of a child object.

overload.summary: Gets the parent of a child object.

parameters.parameter: The child of the parent being retrieved.

overload.returns: The parent of the child object.

method.name: InsertItem
method.summary: Inserts a child object into the collection at the specified location.

overload.summary: Inserts a child object into the collection at the specified location.
overload.syntax: protected virtual void InsertItem ( int index, TChild item )

method.name: RemoveItem
method.summary: Removes a child object from the collection.

overload.summary: Removes a child object from the collection.

parameters.parameter: The index of the item being removed.

method.name: SetItem
method.summary: Modifies the value of the child object at the specified location.

overload.summary: Modifies the value of the child object at the specified location.
overload.syntax: protected virtual void SetItem ( int index, TChild item )

parameters.parameter: The index of the child object being modified.
The new value for the child object.

method.name: SetParent
method.summary: Modifies the value of the parent object of the specified child object.

overload.summary: Modifies the value of the parent object of the specified child object.
overload.syntax: protected virtual abstract void SetParent ( TChild child, TParent parent )

parameters.parameter: The child of the parent being modified.
The new value for the parent object.
